name: Honey Garlic Pork Chops Skillet

fit.evidence: Published 483 cal / 7g carb / 49g protein per serving is inside 400-650 cal and <=35g carb. Even the candidate's own real-honey rebuild estimate (~543 cal / ~19g carb) stays comfortably in band. Budget pork-chop skillet dinner, weigh-and-divide scalable to 14, no seafood. FIT.

catalog_collision: Shares the honey-garlic-pork FLAVOR identity with catalog 'slow-cooker-honey-garlic-pork-bowls' (garlic,honey,pork-loin,soy-sauce,rice,broccoli). Ruled KEEP not DUPE: only 2 of 4 axes match (protein + sauce family). Method differs (quick skillet sear vs slow-cooker braise), format/starch differs (whole boneless chop, no starch, butter+ACV pan glaze vs shredded pork loin over rice with broccoli in a soy-honey-garlic bowl). Different dinner despite near-identical name -- flagged borderline so the audit stage sees the flavor overlap.
pool_collision_note: Only my one candidate in front of me; no pork pool-mate to compare.
cross_protein_watch: Honey-garlic glaze is protein-agnostic: a 'honey garlic chicken thighs skillet' or 'honey garlic chicken' in the chicken selector's pool would be structurally the SAME plate with poultry swapped -- decider should check other-protein pools for a honey-garlic skillet twin, since the sauce is the dish identity here.
unmapped_ok: Carries branded 'Wholesome Yum Zero Sugar Honey' -> rebuild on real honey; honey may lack a board id. Not penalized per v2.1 5.1 (pricer-lane exercise wanted).
one_sentence: KEEP-borderline: FIT on macros (483/7g, in band even rebuilt at ~543/19g), and though it shares the honey-garlic-pork flavor with catalog slow-cooker-honey-garlic-pork-bowls it is a distinct skillet whole-chop no-starch dinner (only 2 of 4 dish axes match).
